articles.title: From a Doctor's Rescue to a Baked Bean Superhero: The Unforgettable Sideshow of UK Elections
articles.summary: Beyond the wins and losses, the 2026 UK elections delivered a candidate collapse, a quick-acting doctor-rival, and Captain Beany in a baked-bean tie. These moments reveal the humanity behind the politics.

articles.title: At 100, David Attenborough Remains the Humble Voice of a Planet in Peril
articles.summary: David Attenborough, the world's most beloved naturalist, turns 100 today. His career spans 70 years of bringing wildlife into homes—and increasingly, sounding the alarm on climate change.

articles.title: The Chaotic Race to Repossess Spirit Airlines' Fleet: Jeans, Sheriffs, and a 70% Fuel Spike
articles.summary: Spirit Airlines' shutdown left over 90 planes stranded. Now, repossession crews face airport resistance, and soaring jet fuel costs complicate the sell-off of its yellow Airbus fleet.
